question: Khamba-Thoibi is an important form of performing arts of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khamba-Thoibi: ** 

 
 
• **Khamba-Thoibi is a folk dance of Moirang** which was the **ancient kingdom of Manipur.**
 
• People of Manipur believed that the dance was first performed by Khamba, a hero in Manipuri mythology and his lover Thoibi who was the princess of the Moirang.
 
• This dance is based on the beautiful love story of the **couple Khamba and Thoibi.**
 
• In order to perform this dance, the male dancers pick up their partners to the dance arena and the female dancers decorate themselves with colorful dresses and flowers in their hands.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Performing arts in Nagaland, Puducherry and Lakshadweep:**

 
 
• The major folk **dances of Nagaland include Modse, Butterfly dance, Rengma, Leshalaptu, Shankai, Seecha, Kukui kucho, etc.**
 
• People in Nagaland perform a war dance known as **'Chang lo'** to celebrate victory in war.
 
• **Garadi **is a well-known **dance in Puducherry.** It is performed at festivals.
 
• It is believed that when Lord Rama (hero of Ramayana) defeated Ravana, at that time vanar sena (group of monkeys) performed this dance to celebrate the victory.
 
• The important form of performing arts of **Lakshadweep is Kolkali and Parichakli. **
 
• Lava is also an important form of dance here.
